correctness.rationale: The adjacent-edge pairs reduce to three explicit resolving-neighborhood forms. The page-pair form forces at least r-1 non-spine selections. Equality implies one omitted page and one selected vertex on each other page; the two remaining neighborhood forms then force at least two a-selections and two b-selections. These conditions also meet every neighborhood, giving a necessary-and-sufficient basis classification and the exact count. Exhaustive definition-level checks for r=5..8 confirm every smaller set fails and every minimum set matches the theorem.
